title: Be Strong and Don't Give Up
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of brave starts that keep going, and tonight Azariah tells Asa, be strong and let not your hands be weak: Beau grips his handlebars, keeps trying all week, and rides to the end of the street.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Beau is the Traveler who makes a brave start and then keeps going, and tonight a prophet tells King Asa to be strong and not give up. In Beau’s world today: Beau is learning to ride his bike without training wheels. He wobbles, he tips, and he scrapes his knee on the sidewalk. His hands are shaking, and he wants to quit. Dad kneels down and says, “Be strong, buddy. Don’t let those hands go weak.” Beau grips the handlebars and tries again every day that week. On Saturday he rides all the way to the end of the street. Just like King Asa, Beau learned that God helps us be strong, and good work is never wasted.
